baseline.rationale: v13 exactly. Reproduces the sealed values and anchors every other arm.

cosine.rationale: H91. M89 measured a median feature L2 norm of 46.81 with no normalisation anywhere in v13, so norm variation is currently inside every distance the boundary reads.

domain_centred.rationale: H91. Subtracts the fit-set mean of a row's own domain, attacking the 32.295 sibling-cell gap M89 measured directly.

domain_centred_null.rationale: N90.3. Identical group count and identical group sizes, assigned at random instead of by domain.

domain_mixture.rationale: H90. 216 cells at support >= 100 plus 128 class-level components, at the largest rank the standing floor permits.

domain_mixture_null.rationale: N90.3. Identical component count, sizes and rank, with cells drawn at random instead of by domain.

control_defect.consequence: The control is left exactly as registered and its verdict stands for this run: domain_mixture is instrument_invalid and its operands are suppressed, so H90 is undetermined rather than refuted. Repairing a control after seeing it fail an arm is the error this program exists to avoid, so the repair is registered as M90.1 and applied to every arm including the baseline.
control_defect.control: known_split negative control, inherited from M85 via N90.8
control_defect.does_not_void: M85's figures stand. Its arms passed this control, and passing a mis-aimed control does not invalidate a measurement; only the docstring's claim about what the control demonstrates is wrong.
control_defect.evidence: All six arms sit below 0.5 on it, from 0.4751 to 0.4860, which is a one-sided bias rather than the noise a genuine null split would produce.
control_defect.finding: The control halves the report rows by position, and those rows are sorted by class, so the two halves are classes 0-64 and 64-127 with exactly one class in common. It is a class-block split, not a random split of comparable rows, and what it measures is whether a scorer assigns systematically different scores to the lower and upper halves of the class index. M85's docstring states the control 'measures the scorer rather than the split'; the domain mixture of the two halves is indeed matched, but the class membership is disjoint.

controls.rationale: N90.8. Generated inside each arm's own transformed space from that arm's own fit rows.

coverage.rationale: N83.3 and N90.7, so every arm is read at the operating point v13 reported recall at.

gate.rationale: H90 and H91 are refuted unless an arm drives mean acceptance multiplicity below the multiplicity bar, exceeds v13's rejection recall, and exceeds v13's AUROC by more than the margin. All three, against the arm's own null where it has one.

openset.evaluation_rationale: The same 5760 rows M84 read, M85 ranked and M89 described.

registered_question: Plan v14 sections 4 and 6.2: do domain-aware components or corrected coordinates recover rejection, without training anything?
registration_notes: N90.1 - registered before any arm was run. H90 says the acceptance overlap is misspecification, one unimodal region per class across six domains. H91 says it is an artefact of unnormalised, un-centred coordinates in which domain is the dominant axis. Both are refuted unless an arm clears all three bars in the gate block against the sealed v13 values on identical rows.

N90.2 - if every arm ties or loses, that is the result and it is recorded as such. A null across the three cheapest available corrections is a materially stronger statement of v13's finding than v13 could make, because it rules out the explanations that do not require training anything. No arm is selected after its operands are seen and no losing arm is retuned.

N90.3 - R5. Every arm that has a free choice carries a null sharing structure, budget and split. The domain-centred arm's null centres by a random partition with matched group sizes; the mixture arm's null uses identical component count, identical component sizes and identical rank with cells drawn as disjoint random subsets instead of by domain. The cosine arm has no free parameter, so the baseline on identical rows is its null. An operand without its null is not evidence.

N90.4 - the standing floor of 10 fit samples per fitted tangent dimension is not waived for any arm. The mixture arm pays for 344 components with rank 10 against the baseline's 51, which is a real cost registered in advance and held constant by its null.

N90.5 - the mixture's class-level component covers every row of its class, so the domain cells are a refinement rather than a partition. The residual-as-component alternative was measured and rejected before this config was written: the smallest per-class residual is 11 rows at a threshold of 100 and 3 rows at 50, permitting ranks of 1 and 0. Recorded so the design is not mistaken for a convenience.

N90.6 - the domain-centred arm requires a domain label at evaluation time. DomainNet supplies one; an open world does not. The arm is an attribution of cause, not a deployable capability, and may not be reported as one.

N90.7 - coverage is matched per class over the union of that class's components, never per component. One offset scales all of a class's radii until 90 percent of its calibration rows are accepted by at least one component. Matching per component would fix each component's own coverage and defeat the arm.

N90.8 - instrument validation is per arm and runs before any figure in that arm is read (N85.4d). Far-field points are generated in each arm's own transformed space from that arm's own fit rows, so the control scales with the arm rather than with the baseline. An arm failing either control reports instrument_invalid and every operand below it is suppressed.
N90.9 - no figure here may revisit a v13 verdict. Outcome C stands as sealed, H83 and H84 stay refuted, and a threshold-free result may not overturn a threshold result (N85.4a).

seeds.rationale: Fixed before execution. The nulls are drawn once, not searched over.

h90_misspecification.basis: domain_mixture must clear all three bars and beat its null.

h91_coordinates.basis: cosine or domain_centred must clear all three bars, and domain_centred must beat its null.

verdict.reading: At least one hypothesis is undetermined because the arm that would decide it failed its own instrument validation. An invalid instrument is void, not negative (N90.8), so M91 does not open on it.
